newsitem.title: USA: Whole Foods to acquire Bread of Life.
newsitem.headline: Whole Foods to acquire Bread of Life.

text.p: Whole Foods Market Inc and Bread of Life said on Friday Whole Foods agreed to acquire Bread of Life in a stock merger.
Whole Foods Market will issue approximately 106,000 shares of common stock valued at $2.15 million and will assume certain long-term debt, the companies said.
This transaction is intended to qualify as a pooling of interests for accounting and financial reporting purposes and is scheduled to close by the end of March.
Bread of Life, which had 1996 revenues of $13 million, owns two natural foods supermarkets in Florida with a third store under development, the companies said.
The Bread of Life acquisition will give Whole Foods Market a total of four stores in the state of Florida, the companies said.
Whole Foods, which owns and operates 70 natural foods supermarkets, said it also signed leases for relocation into larger sites in Houston and San Antonio.
